chunks: Ali ibn Mahziyar from Uthman ibn Isa from Abu Maryam from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about the sermon of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) before the prayer or after it. He said, 'Before the prayer, then he prays.'
ai.seo_question: When did the Prophet Muhammad deliver his sermon in relation to the congregational prayer?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on Friday prayers, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) confirms the Sunnah of delivering the khutbah before the two rak'ahs of the main congregational prayer. This establishes the structural precedence of the sermon over the prayer act, a key distinction in Shia fiqh that differentiates the ritual order from some other schools. It underscores the Prophet’s (PBUH) and Imams’ consistent practice of addressing the community spiritually before engaging in the physical act of worship.
